position_overview:
Job Title: ABA Practice Operations & Medical Billing Virtual Assistant

Position Type: Part-Time | 20 hours per week
Location: Remote
- Philippines
Pay Rate: $6-$7 USD/hour
key_responsibilities:
, troubleshoot systems, and keep daily operations organized.

1. Practice Administration & Client Coordination
- Manage daily emails, incoming calls, text messages, scheduling, and administrative follow-ups.
- Coordinate client intake, onboarding paperwork, referrals, and related communications.
- Maintain organized client records, documents, and administrative trackers.
- Assist with appointment reminders, missed calls, and general inquiries using Google Voice.
- Communicate professionally with families, insurance representatives, and other stakeholders.

2. Medical Billing & Insurance Coordination
- Submit ABA therapy claims daily using Office Ally.
- Track unpaid claims, rejected claims, denials, appeals, and accounts receivable (A/R).
- Assist with payment posting, reconciliation, copays, secondary insurance, and weekly billing reports.
- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, and manage authorization requests and renewals.
- Handle Tricare West insurance workflows and communicate directly with insurance companies.
- Use Availity for insurance verification, authorizations, and payer-related submissions.

3. Systems Management & Technical Support
- Assist with organizing, maintaining, and troubleshooting healthcare and administrative systems.
- Support Motivity for scheduling, client records, clinical documentation, data collection, and practice management.
- Help troubleshoot Availity, Office Ally, and other software issues.
- Organize Microsoft 365, Outlook, calendars, shared folders, and administrative documents.
- Support DocuSign, PandaDoc, and electronic intake workflows.
- Coordinate with software vendors and technical support teams when needed.
- Develop and maintain trackers, SOPs, checklists, and organized workflows.

4. Hiring, Onboarding & Marketing Support
- Post job openings, review applications, and assist with initial candidate screening.
- Schedule interviews and follow up with applicants.
- Track hiring documents, background checks, credentialing requirements, and employee onboarding.
- Maintain organized recruitment and employee records.
- Assist with advertising leads, inquiries, and basic marketing administration as needed.
- Experience in ABA therapy administration and/or medical billing, with a solid understanding of ABA workflows.
- Knowledge of ABA billing processes, including CPT codes, claims submission, authorizations, denials, and insurance follow-ups.
- Tricare West billing and authorization experience, including experience from other medical specialties combined with ABA billing knowledge.
- Experience with medical billing systems, insurance portals, and eligibility verification.
- Strong healthcare administrative experience, including scheduling, client communication, documentation, and follow-ups.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
- Comfortable using email, phone, text, WhatsApp, and video calls for communication and training.
- Tech-savvy, resourceful, and able to learn new software and troubleshoot issues independently.
- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, reliability, and accountability.
- Ability to multitask, prioritize

, and work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
- Direct experience supporting an ABA therapy practice in both administrative and billing functions.
- Experience with Office Ally, Motivity, and Availity.
- Familiarity with Blue Shield, Health Net, and Cigna/Evernorth insurance workflows.
- Experience with Microsoft 365, Outlook, Google Voice, DocuSign, or PandaDoc.
- Experience coordinating client intake, referrals, and onboarding.
- Background in recruitment coordination, staff onboarding, or healthcare practice operations.
- Experience developing SOPs, maintaining trackers, and improving administrative workflows.
- Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus, but not required.

Basic Requirements
- Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant work experience.
- Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements
- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
- Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
- Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
- Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
